Which forecast accuracy metric to report to a CFO

By Dana Okonkwo. Published 14 May 2026. Last updated 30 June 2026.

Report weighted MAPE and forecast bias, not plain MAPE. Plain MAPE divides by actual demand, so a single unit sold against a forecast of three produces a 200% error that swamps the report.

Why plain MAPE misleads on slow movers

On a SKU selling 1 unit a week, a one-unit miss is a 100% error. In a catalogue where 60% of SKUs sell fewer than 5 units a week, plain MAPE reports the tail, not the business.

What weighted MAPE fixes

Weighting each SKU error by its revenue share makes the metric track the money. On a typical Brightpath customer catalogue, weighted MAPE lands 18 to 24 points below plain MAPE.

Why bias belongs next to it

Accuracy without direction hides a systematic over-forecast. Report bias as signed percentage of forecast, and treat anything outside plus or minus 4% as a model problem, not noise.
